assumptions: The input text is a string
The split() method will handle all whitespace characters (including tabs and multiple spaces) into a single space
The lower() method is called after whitespace collapsing to ensure the result is lowercase

 def normalize_label(text: str) -> str:
     """Return a canonical label: lower-case, trimmed, internal whitespace collapsed to one space."""

parsed_response.summary: The original function simply returned the lowercase version of the input text without trimming or collapsing whitespace. The fix uses text.split() to collapse all whitespace into a single space, then applies lower() to ensure lowercase.
